name: McpHub::connect

test_list.description: Connect through the supervised stdio launcher, negotiate MCP, list and call a tool, then confirm the fixture child exited.
Connect to a local streamable HTTP fixture, list and call a tool, and disconnect.
A RepoUnapproved server is denied before the injected launcher is invoked.
Startup and call timeouts accept the inclusive 120-second maximum, reject zero or larger values, and result limits stay within the frame cap.
Plain HTTP to a public hostname is rejected even when no custom headers are configured, while loopback HTTP remains valid.

inputs.name: hub
inputs.description: Hub that owns live MCP sessions.

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Transport, trust, timeout, bounds, and secret references.

output_description: A live initialized session, or a typed sanitized error with failed startup resources cleaned up.
